name: MM-Embed
description: MM-Embed is a universal multimodal retrieval benchmark and model that supports multiple modalities and diverse retrieval tasks. It evaluates multimodal large language models fine-tuned as bi-encoder retrievers across 10 datasets and 16 retrieval tasks, addressing modality bias and improving retrieval performance on benchmarks such as M-BEIR and MTEB.
reputation: A recent but promising retrieval benchmark that has started to attract interest in multimodal embedding and retrieval research, though it is not yet as established as MTEB or BEIR.
notes: Includes modality-aware hard negative mining and continuous fine-tuning; supports complex text-image composed queries.
